required_outcomes: Recognises everything needed to close is now in the record: the invoice (CH-2291, £72.00 including VAT, for the approved new handle) and the tenant's written confirmation that the window opens and locks.
Records the work as complete, citing the tenant's email of 13 February and Cedar Homes' email of 12 February.
Records the invoice at £72.00 from Cedar Homes for payment, consistent with the landlord's approval to fit a new handle.
Tells the landlord (Palmer) the handle has been replaced, when, and the invoice amount, and closes the job with payment.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord to confirm he is happy with the £72.00 before paying, since his approval did not name a figure, provided the job is otherwise ready to close.
Sending the tenant a short closing message thanking her.
positive_behaviours: Notes that Cedar Homes never confirmed the appointment in advance, so the tenant's confirmation is the evidence the visit happened.
Files the invoice PDF on the job rather than skipping the document as 'not needed'.
Releases the hold placed on 12 February.
red_flags: Escalating to a human or keeping the job open waiting for something that has already arrived.
Sending Cedar Homes another booking or invoice reminder.
prohibited_actions: Recording an invoice figure other than £72.00.
Closing without telling the landlord the outcome and cost.
critical_failures: Leaving the completed, invoiced and tenant-confirmed job open with no action, or charging the tenant.
